title: Xdrip shows wrong BG values - Bubble/libre
body:
Hi,
I have problems with xDrip readings on newest stable version. 
It's way off than Libre reading straight from the sensor or the Bubble. You can see what I mean in the picture, where xDrip BG could be 3-5 mmol higher, than the actual Libre or BG meter reading. When I found this, I recalibrated xDrip with correct BG values, which can be seen in the picture, but readings were still off.
Can anyone suggest a solution to get the actual Libre/bubble values without xDrip interfering?
![Screenshot_20201022-201423](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/55350273/96914167-ef7beb80-14a4-11eb-9412-3048ed1fbb71.jpg)
Thanks

comments.body: @bubbledevteam Please can you have a look?

 Same here. Diabetes m and blood sugar was 50units more than xdrip and diabox reading. Only after latest xdrip and latest fw for bubble and 3 phone restarts finally got a true value.

Hi,
It's happening again on the latest Xdrip nightly version from 2 days ago. I checked in the Diabox app and the results seem ok, so looks like the problem is in xDrip. I did calibration when I changed the sensor yesterday and it seemed ok (after 22.00 in the bottom ss), but I got very unreliable results after I woke up. I did another calibration but still no luck. Libre reader and Diabox data look ok, just xDrip seems a way off the usual.
Pictures go from bottom to top:
![Screenshot_20210131-190407_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/55350273/106393543-f8f7e680-63f7-11eb-8011-24ae15e2aca1.jpg) 30.1 - 21.00 >
![Screenshot_20210131-144727_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/55350273/106393544-fa291380-63f7-11eb-8f5c-f6b938ae2107.jpg) 31.1 - 10.00 > 15.00
![Screenshot_20210131-131136_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/55350273/106393546-fac1aa00-63f7-11eb-8c15-59fba6444919.jpg) 30.1 - 21.00 >
@user-hash Did you concat the bubbledevteam directly? They are responsible for the xDrip integration. We don't know much about their device and communication.

@tolot27 Not yet, I just read that xDrip support is unofficial atm. Diabox app shows correct numbers, without these strange jumps. Could you look at 1st screenshot of the post above? I noticed that the insulin rate stays at 12, although you can see it should be at least 13 when I did combined bolus and carb intake, not accounting for many before and after boluses - this is probably not connected to this issue though
After going back to the latest stable version, the discrepancy between the results seems to normalize.
EDIT: if I try to read from Diabox app, the collector won't work, I believe this is a problem with Diabox app
Do you see Insulin level when looking in History? I thought this was displayed before, but I only see a green line for today?
Thanks for help!

@user-hash Again, we cannot help you with the bubble device and as @bubbledevteam already requested in the comment [above](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1482#issuecomment-749941467), you should contact them directly.
